subject: Prod activation: final sanity checklist & ops handshake
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, cloudops@acme-corp.com
Cc: Samir Patel <netops@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Prod activation: final sanity checklist & ops handshake

Team / Acme,

Per our run-of-show, we are targeting the production activation window for the private deployment on 2026-12-01 03:00 UTC. This thread is to confirm the final network preflight items and the smoke-runbook playback sequence so we have a clear ops handshake. Quick summary of asks from Redwood: 

- Confirm that the following network artifacts are in place and will be stable during the window: peering, VPN tunnels, firewall ACLs for model-serving ports (see attached diagram).
- Confirm DNS entries (internal A and SRV records) and TTLs for the service VIPs.
- Confirm maintenance window for any scheduled changes on the Acme side; if there is a collision we need to shift by ±30 minutes.
- We will execute the smoke_playbook steps in order: bootstrap infra checks -> kv cache warmup -> canary queries (read+generate) -> latency/cost telemetry baseline -> failover verification (secondary region). See attached smoke_test_playbook_v1.md and canary_metrics_template.csv.

If you can reply with an explicit ACK and any risks by EOD PST today I will lock the runbook and share the activation bridge details.

Attachments: redwood_prod_network_diagram_v3.pdf, smoke_test_playbook_v1.md, canary_metrics_template.csv

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Program Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@acme-corp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <netops@acme-corp.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Prod activation: final sanity checklist & ops handshake

Vanessa,

Thanks for the checklist — ACK from Acme network/CloudOps. Quick notes from our side: 

- Peering and VPN tunnels are configured and persistently up; we validated MTU and no fragmentation on a 1-hour soak.
- Firewall team will open the service CIDR to the listed ports at T-15m and keep them open until T+30m. I attached the firewall rule export for reference.
- DNS records are staged with a 60s TTL for the activation window and will be promoted at T+2m after canary success.
- One scheduling note: our infra has a scheduled backup at 02:45–03:15 UTC which overlaps T. We can either: (A) shift backup earlier by 30m (preferred) or (B) delay activation by +30m. We should avoid (C) because backups spike IOPS.

I'll coordinate with Samir on the backup change; Samir, can you confirm if shifting is OK?

Attaching: acme_firewall_rules_snapshot_11302026.json (small, exported ruleset)

—Claire
Claire Huang
Cloud Operations Manager, Acme Corp
claire.huang@acme-corp.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Claire Huang <claire.huang@acme-corp.com>, Samir Patel <netops@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Prod activation: final sanity checklist & ops handshake

On Mon, Nov 30, 2026 at 10:03 AM Claire Huang <claire.huang@acme-corp.com> wrote:
> Vanessa,
>
> Thanks for the checklist — ACK from Acme network/CloudOps.

Thanks — good to see the MTU and TTL details. From the SRE side I've captured a concise playback we will follow; listing here so the bridge has a single source of truth: 

1) Preflight (T-60m to T-15m): infra health checks (disk, network flaps), confirm all service certs present, verify Prometheus scrape targets for model-serving.
2) ACL open (T-15m): confirm firewall rules applied (Claire/Samir to ACK).
3) KV warmup (T-10m): run cache-populate job against canary tenant; expect <250ms p90.
4) Canary queries (T+0m): 10 read queries and 5 generation queries across two models (small/medium). Pass criteria: errors < 1%, p95 latency < 600ms, token cost within expected range per canary_metrics_template.csv.
5) Telemetry baseline (T+2m): collect 5m of telemetry and compare to baseline; if any threshold breaches, automatic fallback to hosted variant and abort.
6) Failover check (T+10m): initiate a controlled regional failover to the secondary rack and confirm traffic shifts and recovery.
7) Post-checks (T+20m): retention of logs, start warm-up for production traffic pattern, and handoff to CS/Customer Ops.

I'll own the canary execution and telemetry checks; Laura will run the failover verification and Stephanie will validate cost/billing tagging. If Claire can confirm ACL open and backup shift outcome by 12:00 PST I will mark step 2 green and proceed. I linked the JIRA INF-2147 for runbook playbacks and uploaded the canary metrics template to the Drive link.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com | ext. 7421

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Prod activation: final sanity checklist & ops handshake

Perfect — appreciate the quick turn. To confirm the plan and ops handshake:

- Claire/Samir: please confirm backup shift by 15:00 PST (12:00 UTC) — if that cannot happen we delay start by +30m.
- Marcus: proceed to lock the playback steps and populate the bridge notes; we will use the Drive folder for runbook artifacts.
- Laura/Stephanie: be on the activation bridge T-15m for ACL validation and T+20m for handoff.

I will issue the calendar invite for the activation bridge with read-only Bridge link and escalation phone numbers. Once Claire confirms the backup shift I will set the final T and update the calendar.

Sign-off: Vanessa Ortiz — locking plan contingent on Acme backup adjustment.
